summary: CalMatters lists Berman as voting Aye on AB 715, a California bill creating an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight; the bill's text does not explicitly name IHRA. He also coauthored the failed AB 1468, which would have focused high-school ethnic studies on domestic experiences. Activist Samir Laymoun, an owner-requested opinion source separate from official BAMC Action positions, opposes Berman in the general election.
